certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Cybersecurity for Defense and Space

learning_outcomes.text: Explain why defense and space systems are high-value cyber targets
Describe core security principles: confidentiality, integrity and availability
Describe threats and attack surfaces across ground and space segments conceptually
Explain defensive controls, zero-trust and secure-by-design ideas
Describe supply-chain and operational security concepts at a high level
Communicate cyber risk and controls to stakeholders

integrative_case: A security class reviews, at concept level only, the cyber posture of a satellite ground-control service: they identify assets and attack surfaces across segments, apply the CIA triad and defense-in-depth, consider supply-chain and operational security, and present prioritised defensive recommendations - no offensive detail.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
